verdict.rationale: Exa documents an `output_schema` parameter that works with any search type to extract structured JSON from search results. The JS SDK confirms schema enforcement for object types. The Exa Agent and Websets enrichment fields also return structured results. missing for 10: support for complex schemas (search enforces max nesting depth 2 and max 10 properties), in-depth schema documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of schema-conformant output.
